faqs.question: How many ink colors does the printer use and what size are the ink packs?
faqs.answer: The printer uses six colors: Black, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, White, and Varnish. The ink packs are 140mL.

faqs.question: What are the power specifications to use the printer?
faqs.answer:
Voltage:
AC 100-120 V, 50-60 Hz

faqs.question: Do I need to ventilate the room where the printer is installed?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Air should vent out of the room, and fresh air should come into the room. Air should not circulate in the room. The Epson UltraChrome UV ink smell can cause some irritation and possible discomfort.
Note:
The Epson SureColor V1070 must be placed in a room whose ventilation system is capable of 10 to 15 ACH (air changes per hour). An additional system may be required if the existing ventilation system is inadequate. There is a rear attachment on the printer to connect to a third-party ventilation device.

faqs.question: What is the maximum media size, thickness and weight I can use in the printer?
faqs.answer: The maximum media size is 8.3 × 11.7 in. (210 mm × 297 mm). The maximum thickness is 2.7 in. (70 mm). The maximum media weight is 6.5 lbs.

faqs.question: Does the printer operator need to wear safety equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes, during maintenance, some ink splashes and ink aerosols can occur. Technicians must wear the appropriate PPE listed below:
Ansell Edmont Neoprene 865 or Solvex Nitrile Rubber number 275 gloves
Polyethylene or equivalent gloves to be worn under the gloves listed above
N95-style face mask with charcoal linings to cover mouth, nose, and lower jaw
Full coverage goggles, sufficient to protect eyes from ink splashes and aerosols
Adequate clothing to protect skin from ink splashes and aerosols

faqs.question: Can I combine third-party ink with the Epson UltraChrome UV ink?
faqs.answer: Epson does not recommend using third-party ink with Epson UltraChrome UV ink. Combining the inks can damage the ink lines and/or print heads. Use only Epson UltraChrome UV ink with the printer.

faqs.question: What are the system requirements to operate the printer?
faqs.answer: A computer that supports Windows 8.1 (64-bit) or later to run the Epson Edge Print software.

faqs.question: How do I cure the UV ink?
faqs.answer:
The printer will cure the UV ink with a UV light on the printer carriage.
Note:
The printer should not be placed in direct sunlight, or the UV ink will cure prematurely, which may ruin the print production and/or cause damage to the ink system and print head.
